title: Legal passport
description: The passport of the legal texts, legal/legal.yaml (section 4 of the legal text): the texts, their versions with their status, date and summary, and the sets of texts of the samples page.

format.description: The version of the part, the integer in legal/VERSION.

additionalProperties.description: A text: where it is shown, and its versions.
A set of texts of the samples page: the notice of a purpose and its form, under one version.

sets.description: The sets of texts of the samples page, by their IDs.

id.description: The ID of a text or of a set: lower-case Latin letters and digits in words joined by hyphens, beginning with a letter.

set_id.description: The ID of a set: as the ID of a text, of at most 24 characters, so that the set's ID and version joined by a hyphen fit the 32 characters of a sample's text_set_version.

place.description: Where the text is shown: app, on its pages and consents; samples_page, the notice of a set of texts; form, a form a person signs outside every screen.

versions.description: The versions of the text, from 1 on, in order.
The versions of the set, from 1 on, in order.

status.description: draft, shown to nobody and free to change; or in_force, approved by the author and never changed again.

in_force_since.description: The date the author approved the version, YYYY-MM-DD. Only a version in force has it, and it always has it.

summary.description: The gist of the version in each language of the interface, by the language's tag: what a screen in that language shows beside the English text in force. A self-hosted copy writes both too: one build of app serves every copy.

items.description: The tag of a language of the interface other than English.

translations.description: The languages of the interface other than English that the version has a translation in: a file of its own, texts/<id>/<n>.<tag>.md, with no force of its own, which a screen in that language shows beside the English text in force. A version in force keeps its translations as it keeps its file.

notice.description: The notice the samples page shows before writing.

form.description: The form a person signs outside the page, before the first sample.
